objective: Test whether adding a jieba word-level n-gram text head to the frozen V15 char n-gram head, and raising the text share of the final score from 0.25 to 0.35, improves stable net marginal alpha beyond the same-data V13 baseline and beyond the V15 char-only line replicated under identical accounting.
motivation_pre_registered: V15 reported that announcement-title text was the only component carrying positive incremental excess (+5.18pp ungated, +4.46pp over the same-data V13 baseline) while using the simplest possible representation (char 2-4 gram hashing with a linear regressor). The V15 frozen report itself lists pretrained embeddings and richer text representations as the main unexplored margin.
immutability: V15 data, code, lock and results remain unchanged; V16 reuses the V15 event document file and the V15 quality verdicts as inputs.

data.event_source: the frozen V15 event document file data/event_documents_pit_v15.csv, byte-identical, verified by SHA-256 against the V15 quality report
data.market_membership_fundamentals_industry: the same frozen V10/V14 input files locked by V15

char_head.note: byte-identical to the frozen V15 text head so that the replica mode reproduces V15 exactly

word_head.analyzer: jieba.lcut tokens with blank tokens removed
word_head.determinism: jieba is deterministic given a fixed version; the version is recorded in the lock environment

text_representation.ensemble: per event and horizon, char and word head predictions are blended 0.5/0.5 before the fixed horizon weighting

targets.definition: identical to V15: next-open to horizon-exit-open return minus point-in-time official-weight broad-sector return minus the pre-existing liquidity-aware round-trip cost
targets.label_maturity: identical to V15: 20-day label end must be before the cutoff minus a 28-calendar-day embargo

model.text_regressor: per head, three chronological averaged elastic-net Huber SGD regressors with a fixed 30 epochs and no tolerance-based early stop, identical hyper-parameters to V15
model.final_score: 65 percent same-data V13 comparable score plus 35 percent recent char+word ensemble text score
model.replica_score: 75 percent same-data V13 comparable score plus 25 percent recent char-only text score, evaluated only as an attribution anchor; it must reproduce the V15 ungated line under the V16 accounting stack

attribution_modes.v15_char_replica: V15 final score replicated under V16 accounting
attribution_modes.v16_text_ungated: the V16 candidate without nested-validation gates
attribution_modes.v16_text_gated: the V16 formal line, falling back to the benchmark in test years where nested validation fails

gates.replacement: the 17 V15 retrospective gates applied to v16_text_gated, unchanged
gates.attribution: the ungated V16 ensemble line must not deliver cumulative excess below the V15 char replica line evaluated in the same run
gates.nested_validation: identical to V15: pooled payoff lower bound, incremental lower bound, technology bounds and per-validation-year floors must pass in every test year before the gated line may select stocks

portfolio: identical to V15: Top-30 active budget 15 percent, per-stock active weight 0.75 percent, sector neutrality, ex-ante tracking error cap 6 percent, 20-trading-day rebalances, V10 accounting

decision_rule.all_gates_passed: status becomes a paper-trade candidate only; the production model remains V6 and no execution is authorized
decision_rule.any_gate_failed: decision stays keep_v6; results are retained as reproducible research
decision_rule.no_post_hoc_changes: after freezing, neither parameters nor inputs may be modified; re-running requires a new pre-registered version

honest_reporting: 2020-2025 has been observed by V4 through V15 research lines; any success on this window is weaker evidence than the future shadow protocol
the text share increase from 0.25 to 0.35 is motivated by V15's frozen attribution evidence and is locked before any V16 evaluation
a failure of the attribution gate must be reported as evidence that the word head adds nothing, not discarded
